project_info.name: Shipready
project_info.target_viewport: Mobile-safe down to 390px up to 1440px+ display

design_archetype.name: Dark Brutalist Monospace Ledger
design_archetype.vibe: High-density, precision-engineered, ruthless financial transparency, dark minimal
core_principles: Zero fluff: pure typography, 1px rules, sharp boundaries
Signal over noise: #c6f24e reserved for critical prices, status triggers, and active CTA
Financial precision: tabular numbers font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums everywhere for figures
Monospace codes: IDs, hashes, certificate codes, and webhook secrets always set in mono font
Mandatory disclaimer on money: Every monetary figure labelled 'estimated / ledger-derived, not bank settlement'

landing.title: Three slots. One offer. One price.
components: Minimal header with logo & proof link
Hero section with $1,090.00 price in big signal color (#c6f24e)
Arithmetic block explaining $1,038.09 net contribution per close
Offer details: 'Shipready Sprint' scope & delivery promise
Primary CTA button: 'Take a slot' linking to /s/shipready-sprint
Footer with disclaimers and operator portal link (/access)

store.title: Storefront Slot Checkout
states: Open state: 'N of 3 open', test-mode badge if test, 'Take a slot' button driving Stripe checkout
Sold out state: 'Sold out. 3 of 3 slots claimed.', CTA disabled
Payments not configured state: 'Payments not configured.' banner with instructions
Confirmation state (?ok=1): Success banner linking directly to issued certificate /p/:code

access.title: Operator Desk Verification
components: Minimal secret input field
Error state: 'Wrong secret.' in danger style
Submit action routing to /desk on success with persistence

desk.title: Operator Command Desk
components: Metric tiles: Total Contribution vs $1,000 target, Closes Booked, Closes Remaining
Financial Compute Breakdown: Gross, Refunds, Disputes, Fees (Actual vs Est)
Orders Table: state, amount, refunded, certificate code link, full/partial refund action triggers
Status Panel: Operating mode (LIVE/TEST), Webhook URL with copy tool, Webhook secret status, Last webhook received time/type, Unresolved events count
Sweep trigger action button

proof.title: Proof Wall of Certificates
components: Filter/Sort list of issued certificates (newest first)
Badges for LIVE / TEST / REVOKED
Empty state: 'No certificates yet. Nothing here is invented.'

certificate.title: Public Proof Certificate
components: Verification badge: Verified / REVOKED
Mode: LIVE or TEST
Verified contribution arithmetic amount
Issued timestamp in ISO/UTC string
Cryptographic code copy trigger
404 error header: 'Nothing at this address.'
Monospace error log view
Return link to landing /

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the dark minimal palette (#0b0b0d background, #e9e9ee text, #8a8a94 dim, #23232a border, #c6f24e signal).
Do NOT add rounded rounded-lg or rounded-xl curves — keep borders sharp (rounded-none or max rounded-sm) to fit the brutalist ledger archetype.
Every money figure MUST include the disclaimer text: 'estimated / ledger-derived, not bank settlement'.
All numerical values and dollar amounts must have className 'tabular-nums font-mono'.
Use sonner for notifications and toasts.
Ensure all interactive components have proper data-testid attributes as defined in data_testid_rules.
